This is a known behavior in Excel where empty strings in cells can interfere with numeric calculations. 

This is fundamentally a conceptual issue about how Excel handles empty strings versus null values or zeros in formulas. To verify a solution, one would need to understand the difference between empty strings and null/zero values in Excel formulas, which is knowledge-based rather than requiring code execution. The solution likely involves ensuring that cells contain proper numeric values (0 instead of "") when exporting.
